source: R. Lu, Y. Yang, A. E. Hassanien, S. Gong, "Gigahertz low-loss and high power handling acoustic delay lines using thin-film lithium-niobate-on-sapphire," IEEE Trans. Microw. Theory Techn. 69(7), 3246-3254 (2021)
structure: X-cut LiNbO3, 700 nm, on c-plane sapphire; SH-SAW. SPUDT cells of length Lambda: two Lambda/8 electrodes and a Lambda/4 reflector (50 % metallized), 130 nm Al (not modelled here; the gaps are bare LN). The sapphire in-plane orientation is not stated.
orientation: Fig. 1(a): crystal Y at 10 deg from the propagation direction. X-cut phi = -10 here (phi from +Y toward +Z); this sign gives the larger coupling in this tool. Sapphire angle 30 deg is assumed here.

simulated.kind: simulated (COMSOL eigenmode FEA, Sec. II-B, at Lambda = 4.64 um; constants from the paper's refs. 41-42)

adl_f_center.kind: simulated (frequency-domain FEA with the Al electrodes, Sec. II-C/D)

measured.kind: measured (Sec. IV): centre frequency of the passband; group velocity from the delay vs gap length (Group A, gaps 10-800 um, Lambda = 4.64 um, electrically open gap)
